pr.title: feat(cli): add cleanup closed reviews functionality
pr.body:
In my typical workflow, closing a PR is effectively the same to me as merging, in that I'm now done with the branch. This PR adds a config setting to have the CLI automatically clean up closed branches in addition to merged branches:


```sh
❯ /Users/ava/repos/git-stk/target/release/git-stk sync
ava/chore/test-close-behavior: review #44 is closed
sync complete: 0 synced, 0 skipped
updated stack note in #44
will detach ava/chore/test-close-behavior
will delete branch ava/chore/test-close-behavior
stack complete: everything merged into main
```

I'm totally open to suggestions if you see any potential problems with this feature!

P.S. thanks for making such a great tool! I've been looking for a graphite alternative and this seems to fit my needs quite well!

(No AI was involved in the making of this PR)
